policy.description: After a settled forecast loss, lock a challenger before collecting a new confirmation sample. Promote only for lower log loss, non-worse Brier and accuracy, and a paired weekly bootstrap showing improvement. No changes after a single upset.

prediction_record.note: All retained recorded games, one earliest valid pregame prediction per event across model policies. Accuracy = correct / (correct + incorrect). Scheduled, unresolved and unscored games are excluded until a decisive result is verified. Historical games without a saved pregame pick are not reconstructed.

injury_research.note: No injury probability adjustment is approved. A historical research comparison cannot replace the required future promotion checks.

leagues.name: NFL
sources: nflverse public schedules/results, documented by nflreadr load_schedules; select result columns only
leagues.feed_type: Hourly final results and upcoming schedules; not a live play-by-play stream

lifecycle.status: Challenger locked; 24/100 new results across 2/8 weeks.

policy.description: After a settled forecast loss, lock a challenger before collecting a new confirmation sample. Promote only for lower log loss, non-worse Brier and accuracy, and a paired weekly bootstrap showing improvement. No changes after a single upset.

outcome_learning.update_policy: Every newly settled decisive result can trigger an eligible adaptive challenger refit. Both wins and losses update causal team/fighter feedback. Larger unexpected outcomes generate larger residuals; live promotion requires independent accuracy, log-loss and Brier checks.

research.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
research.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

research.note: Expanding development backtests only. Candidate selection gains are optimistic; no new independent test or production improvement is claimed. Original final-test dates were excluded. Production promotion still requires the separate prospective loss-review gate.

backtest_review.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
backtest_review.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

backtest_review.note: Expanding development backtests only. Candidate selection gains are optimistic; no new independent test or production improvement is claimed. Original final-test dates were excluded. Production promotion still requires the separate prospective loss-review gate.

previous_search.name: logistic_ratings_w20_C0.3
previous_search.note: Same development data and chronological validation games; search-selection optimism remains.

drift.note: Compare the latest 50 saved picks with the preceding 50; this is monitoring, not permission to retune a live model.

actions: Collect more pregame evidence before drawing strong conclusions or promoting a challenger.

calibration.note: Binned reliability and resolution are descriptive. The residual reflects within-bin variation; this is not an exact individual-probability Brier decomposition.

diagnostics.note: Uses only actually saved, settled predictions. Team summaries count a game for both teams and must not be summed as independent games. Drift comparisons are observational; schedule difficulty and small samples can change scores.

feedback_report.note: Original saved pregame forecasts under the current prediction policy. Small samples are noisy; the Wilson accuracy interval is descriptive and assumes independent picks. Wins and losses both inform training; no result rewrites a saved pick.

adaptive_review.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
adaptive_review.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

adaptive_review.note: Twenty-one fixed adaptive candidates against the prior development winner, compared on shared expanding pre-final-test dates. Selection is optimistic; only the separate future gate can change production weights.

benchmark.budget: 5 fixed candidates, 3 expanding date-block folds; no random split, no tuning on final 20% of dates; single CPU.

test.interval_note: 200 calendar-week block bootstrap samples of fixed final-test predictions; approximate performance uncertainty, not a game probability interval.

benchmark.outcome_rules: Conditional on a decisive eventual winner, including overtime. Draws and no contests excluded; this is NOT an unconditional win probability or a sportsbook settlement forecast.
benchmark.calibration: No post-hoc calibration; reliability measured on held-out data.
limitations: Result-only baseline; no confirmed injuries, starters, travel, weather or lineups.
Score margin is not possession-adjusted efficiency.
Pre-event feature timestamps are uploader assertions, not independently verified.
Historical performance does not establish present-day calibration.

predictions.rules: Conditional on a decisive eventual winner, including overtime. Draws and no contests excluded; this is NOT an unconditional win probability or a sportsbook settlement forecast.
predictions.availability: Schedule verified. Reported injuries are shown separately; the numerical result-history baseline is not injury-adjusted. Starters and lineups remain unconfirmed.

predictions.explanation: Logistic contributions explain the fitted log odds, not causation. Other models show input differences only; no invented importance scores.

prediction_record.note: All retained recorded games, one earliest valid pregame prediction per event across model policies. Accuracy = correct / (correct + incorrect). Scheduled, unresolved and unscored games are excluded until a decisive result is verified. Historical games without a saved pregame pick are not reconstructed.

lifecycle.status: Challenger locked; 113/100 new results across 3/8 weeks.

policy.description: After a settled forecast loss, lock a challenger before collecting a new confirmation sample. Promote only for lower log loss, non-worse Brier and accuracy, and a paired weekly bootstrap showing improvement. No changes after a single upset.

outcome_learning.update_policy: Every newly settled decisive result can trigger an eligible adaptive challenger refit. Both wins and losses update causal team/fighter feedback. Larger unexpected outcomes generate larger residuals; live promotion requires independent accuracy, log-loss and Brier checks.

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

research.note: Expanding development backtests only. Candidate selection gains are optimistic; no new independent test or production improvement is claimed. Original final-test dates were excluded. Production promotion still requires the separate prospective loss-review gate.

backtest_review.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
backtest_review.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

backtest_review.note: Expanding development backtests only. Candidate selection gains are optimistic; no new independent test or production improvement is claimed. Original final-test dates were excluded. Production promotion still requires the separate prospective loss-review gate.

previous_search.name: kernel_profile_w20_gamma0.03
previous_search.note: Same development data and chronological validation games; search-selection optimism remains.

drift.note: Compare the latest 50 saved picks with the preceding 50; this is monitoring, not permission to retune a live model.

calibration.note: Binned reliability and resolution are descriptive. The residual reflects within-bin variation; this is not an exact individual-probability Brier decomposition.

diagnostics.note: Uses only actually saved, settled predictions. Team summaries count a game for both teams and must not be summed as independent games. Drift comparisons are observational; schedule difficulty and small samples can change scores.

feedback_report.note: Original saved pregame forecasts under the current prediction policy. Small samples are noisy; the Wilson accuracy interval is descriptive and assumes independent picks. Wins and losses both inform training; no result rewrites a saved pick.

adaptive_review.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
adaptive_review.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

adaptive_review.note: Twenty-one fixed adaptive candidates against the prior development winner, compared on shared expanding pre-final-test dates. Selection is optimistic; only the separate future gate can change production weights.

benchmark.budget: 5 fixed candidates, 3 expanding date-block folds; no random split, no tuning on final 20% of dates; single CPU.

test.interval_note: 200 calendar-week block bootstrap samples of fixed final-test predictions; approximate performance uncertainty, not a game probability interval.

benchmark.outcome_rules: Conditional on a decisive eventual winner, including overtime. Draws and no contests excluded; this is NOT an unconditional win probability or a sportsbook settlement forecast.
benchmark.calibration: No post-hoc calibration; reliability measured on held-out data.
limitations: Result-only baseline; no confirmed injuries, starters, travel, weather or lineups.
Score margin is not possession-adjusted efficiency.
Pre-event feature timestamps are uploader assertions, not independently verified.
Historical performance does not establish present-day calibration.

prediction_record.note: All retained recorded games, one earliest valid pregame prediction per event across model policies. Accuracy = correct / (correct + incorrect). Scheduled, unresolved and unscored games are excluded until a decisive result is verified. Historical games without a saved pregame pick are not reconstructed.

injury_research.note: No injury probability adjustment is approved. A historical research comparison cannot replace the required future promotion checks.

leagues.name: CFB
sources: ESPN public scoreboard; completed results and scheduled events only
leagues.feed_type: Hourly final results and upcoming schedules; not a live play-by-play stream

lifecycle.status: Challenger locked; 119/100 new results across 2/8 weeks.

policy.description: After a settled forecast loss, lock a challenger before collecting a new confirmation sample. Promote only for lower log loss, non-worse Brier and accuracy, and a paired weekly bootstrap showing improvement. No changes after a single upset.

outcome_learning.update_policy: Every newly settled decisive result can trigger an eligible adaptive challenger refit. Both wins and losses update causal team/fighter feedback. Larger unexpected outcomes generate larger residuals; live promotion requires independent accuracy, log-loss and Brier checks.

research.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
research.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

research.note: Expanding development backtests only. Candidate selection gains are optimistic; no new independent test or production improvement is claimed. Original final-test dates were excluded. Production promotion still requires the separate prospective loss-review gate.

backtest_review.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
backtest_review.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

backtest_review.note: Expanding development backtests only. Candidate selection gains are optimistic; no new independent test or production improvement is claimed. Original final-test dates were excluded. Production promotion still requires the separate prospective loss-review gate.

previous_search.name: logistic_context_bayesian_w10_C0.3
previous_search.note: Same development data and chronological validation games; search-selection optimism remains.

drift.note: Compare the latest 50 saved picks with the preceding 50; this is monitoring, not permission to retune a live model.

actions: Inspect high-confidence misses and reported player availability; do not assume an injury caused a loss.
Investigate changing form or data coverage and evaluate a frozen adaptive challenger on new dates.

calibration.note: Binned reliability and resolution are descriptive. The residual reflects within-bin variation; this is not an exact individual-probability Brier decomposition.

diagnostics.note: Uses only actually saved, settled predictions. Team summaries count a game for both teams and must not be summed as independent games. Drift comparisons are observational; schedule difficulty and small samples can change scores.

feedback_report.note: Original saved pregame forecasts under the current prediction policy. Small samples are noisy; the Wilson accuracy interval is descriptive and assumes independent picks. Wins and losses both inform training; no result rewrites a saved pick.

adaptive_review.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
adaptive_review.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

adaptive_review.note: Twenty-one fixed adaptive candidates against the prior development winner, compared on shared expanding pre-final-test dates. Selection is optimistic; only the separate future gate can change production weights.

benchmark.budget: 10 fixed candidates, 3 expanding date-block folds; no random split, no tuning on final 20% of dates; single CPU.

test.interval_note: 200 calendar-week block bootstrap samples of fixed final-test predictions; approximate performance uncertainty, not a game probability interval.

benchmark.outcome_rules: Conditional on a decisive eventual winner, including overtime. Draws and no contests excluded; this is NOT an unconditional win probability or a sportsbook settlement forecast.
benchmark.calibration: No post-hoc calibration; reliability measured on held-out data.
limitations: Result-only baseline; no confirmed injuries, starters, travel, weather or lineups.
Score margin is not possession-adjusted efficiency.
Pre-event feature timestamps are uploader assertions, not independently verified.
Historical performance does not establish present-day calibration.

leagues.name: WNBA
sources: ESPN public scoreboard; completed results and scheduled events only
leagues.feed_type: Hourly final results and upcoming schedules; not a live play-by-play stream

lifecycle.status: Challenger locked; 3/100 new results across 1/8 weeks.

policy.description: After a settled forecast loss, lock a challenger before collecting a new confirmation sample. Promote only for lower log loss, non-worse Brier and accuracy, and a paired weekly bootstrap showing improvement. No changes after a single upset.

outcome_learning.update_policy: Every newly settled decisive result can trigger an eligible adaptive challenger refit. Both wins and losses update causal team/fighter feedback. Larger unexpected outcomes generate larger residuals; live promotion requires independent accuracy, log-loss and Brier checks.

research.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
research.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

research.note: Expanding development backtests only. Candidate selection gains are optimistic; no new independent test or production improvement is claimed. Original final-test dates were excluded. Production promotion still requires the separate prospective loss-review gate.

backtest_review.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
backtest_review.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

backtest_review.note: Expanding development backtests only. Candidate selection gains are optimistic; no new independent test or production improvement is claimed. Original final-test dates were excluded. Production promotion still requires the separate prospective loss-review gate.

previous_search.note: Same development data and chronological validation games; search-selection optimism remains.

drift.note: Compare the latest 50 saved picks with the preceding 50; this is monitoring, not permission to retune a live model.

actions: Review overconfidence using chronological calibration challengers; a confidence gap is descriptive, not proof of a cause.
Collect more pregame evidence before drawing strong conclusions or promoting a challenger.

calibration.note: Binned reliability and resolution are descriptive. The residual reflects within-bin variation; this is not an exact individual-probability Brier decomposition.

diagnostics.note: Uses only actually saved, settled predictions. Team summaries count a game for both teams and must not be summed as independent games. Drift comparisons are observational; schedule difficulty and small samples can change scores.

feedback_report.note: Original saved pregame forecasts under the current prediction policy. Small samples are noisy; the Wilson accuracy interval is descriptive and assumes independent picks. Wins and losses both inform training; no result rewrites a saved pick.

adaptive_review.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
adaptive_review.fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

adaptive_review.note: Twenty-one fixed adaptive candidates against the prior development winner, compared on shared expanding pre-final-test dates. Selection is optimistic; only the separate future gate can change production weights.

benchmark.budget: 10 fixed candidates, 3 expanding date-block folds; no random split, no tuning on final 20% of dates; single CPU.

test.interval_note: 200 calendar-week block bootstrap samples of fixed final-test predictions; approximate performance uncertainty, not a game probability interval.

benchmark.outcome_rules: Conditional on a decisive eventual winner, including overtime. Draws and no contests excluded; this is NOT an unconditional win probability or a sportsbook settlement forecast.
benchmark.calibration: No post-hoc calibration; reliability measured on held-out data.
limitations: Result-only baseline; no confirmed injuries, starters, travel, weather or lineups.
Score margin is not possession-adjusted efficiency.
Pre-event feature timestamps are uploader assertions, not independently verified.
Historical performance does not establish present-day calibration.

Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo told reporters Monday that Mena underwent surgery on his right shoulder and will be sidelined for the rest of the season, Jack Sommers of SI.com reports.
Saalfrank (shoulder) has begun a throwing program, Alex Weiner of Arizona Sports reports.

Athletics.description: Hoglund (knee/back) will be sidelined for the rest of the 2026 season after undergoing surgery on his left hip Monday.
The Athletics transferred Sterner (knee) from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Sunday.
Wilson underwent left shoulder labral surgery Wednesday, Martin Gallegos of MLB.com reports.
The Athletics transferred Soderstrom (hip) to the 60-day injured list Thursday.
Rooker (knee) was cleared to begin a hitting progression Wednesday, Martin Gallegos of MLB.com reports.
Muncy underwent debridement surgery Friday to repair cartilage damage under the medial patella in his left knee.
Johnson underwent arthroscopic left knee surgery Monday, Martin Gallegos of MLB.com reports.

Atlanta Braves.description: Atlanta claimed Parker (elbow) off waivers from the Nationals on Monday.

GM Alex Anthopoulos said Sunday that Schwellenbach (elbow) should return to Atlanta's rotation next year, though the organization won't be counting on him to fill that role across the full season, Mark Bowman of MLB.com reports.
Atlanta recalled Waldrep (elbow) from Triple-A Gwinnett on Thursday and placed him on the 60-day injured list.

Atlanta general manager Alex Anthopoulos said Sunday that Strider (elbow) will be a rotation option in 2027, but the organization won't count on him to pitch a full schedule, Mark Bowman of MLB.com reports.

Baltimore Orioles.description: Helsley (elbow) will exercise his $14 million player option for 2027, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.
Orioles president of baseball operations Mike Elias said Monday that Bradish will undergo surgery Tuesday to repair a sports hernia, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.
Orioles president of baseball operations Mike Elias said Monday that Westburg (elbow) will begin a hitting progression this week, Rich Dubroff of BaltimoreBaseball.com reports.
Holliday will undergo left wrist surgery next week, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.
Povich underwent surgery Wednesday to remove loose bodies from his left elbow, Matt Weyrich of The Baltimore Sun reports.
Triple-A Norfolk placed Trimble on the 7-day injured list Friday due to right hamstring discomfort, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.
Foster was removed from an appearance at Triple-A Norfolk on Thursday due to right shoulder discomfort, Roch Kubatko of MASNSports.com reports.

Boston Red Sox.description: Red Sox manager Chad Tracy said Tuesday that Gonzalez is still recovering from a hyperextended elbow injury suffered at Triple-A Worcester but is "very much in play" for the ALDS roster if Boston advances, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.
The Red Sox transferred White (foot) to the 60-day injured list Sunday.
The Red Sox transferred Slaten (elbow) from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Tuesday, Gabrielle Starr of the Boston Herald reports.
Casas (abdomen/knee) underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left wrist Thursday.
Crawford (forearm) is expected to remain on the injured list for the rest of the season, Jen McCaffrey of The Athletic reports.
The Red Sox exercised Whitlock's (leg) $8.25 million club option for 2027 on Sunday, Ari Alexander of 7 News Boston reports.
The Red Sox announced Thursday that Durbin (finger) underwent a successful partial excision of the fifth metatarsal base with tendon repair on his right foot, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
Red Sox chief baseball officer Craig Breslow said Monday that Anthony is not expected to require surgery on his injured right hand, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
Gasper is expected to be sidelined 4-to-6 month after undergoing distal right biceps tendon surgery Friday, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.

Chicago Cubs.description: Cubs manager Craig Counsell said Wednesday that Martin (elbow) has been ruled out for the remainder of the season, Meghan Montemurro of the Chicago Tribune reports.
Brown (neck) has been ruled out for the remainder of the season, Taylor McGregor of Marquee Sports Network reports.
Steele (elbow) is not on the Cubs' roster for their wild-card series versus the Padres, Meghan Montemurro of the Chicago Tribune reports.
The Cubs transferred Maton (knee) to the 60-day injured list Wednesday.

Austin (knee) was outrighted to Triple-A Iowa on Monday.

Chicago White Sox.description: Berroa (elbow) is scheduled to begin throwing off a mound next week, Scott Merkin of MLB.com reports.
Leasure underwent surgery to repair a torn UCL in August, James Fegan of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

Cincinnati Reds.description: Dunn will have ulnar nerve transposition surgery on his right elbow Wednesday, Charlie Goldsmith of Fox 19 Now Cincinnati reports.
Steer recently underwent successful surgery on his right wrist, Mike Petraglia of CLNS Media reports.
Greene (elbow) will be out for 12-to-18 months after undergoing his second Tommy John surgery Wednesday, Gordon Wittenmyer of The Cincinnati Enquirer reports.
Santillan will undergo surgery Thursday to repair a left hip labral tear, Gordon Wittenmyer of The Cincinnati Enquirer reports.
The Reds placed Garcia on the 15-day injured list Friday with loose bodies in his right elbow.

Reds president of baseball operations Nick Krall revealed Thursday that Myers recently underwent arthroscopic surgery to repair the AC joint in his left shoulder, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

Cleveland Guardians.description: Holderman underwent surgery Wednesday to relieve recurring tendinitis in his right wrist, Zack Meisel of The Athletic reports.
Watson underwent sports hernia surgery Tuesday and will be sidelined 8-to-12 weeks.
Walters underwent a right elbow UCL repair with an internal brace Wednesday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.

Colorado Rockies.description: Rockies manager Warren Schaeffer announced Monday that Herrera (elbow) has been diagnosed with a torn UCL and will miss the remainder of the season, Jack Janes of MLB.com reports.
Brown (shoulder) had been scheduled to throw a live bullpen session this weekend, MLB.com reports.
Dollander underwent an internal brace procedure on his right elbow Monday, Kevin Henry of The Denver Gazette reports.

Detroit Tigers.description: Double-A Erie placed Miller on its 7-day injured list Sunday due to an unspecified issue.
Vest (elbow) underwent hip surgery Tuesday, Chris McCosky of The Detroit News reports.
Sweeney will undergo season-ending shoulder surgery this week, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.
Tigers manager A.J. Hinch said Friday that Perez (orbital) is "most likely" done for the season, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.
Olson (shoulder) is taking part in a throwing progression and is expected to be ready for spring training, MLB.com reports.

Houston Astros.description: Medical imaging on Correa's surgically repaired left ankle revealed inflammation Thursday, Chandler Rome of The Athletic reports.

Loperfido underwent arthroscopic surgery recently to repair a labral tear and impingment in his right hip, Chandler Rome of The Athletic reports.

Jenkins underwent right elbow debridement surgery Wednesday, Bobby Nightengale of the Minneapolis Star-Tribune reports.

Brash has been shut down from throwing for eight weeks after an MRI revealed more inflammation in his lat, Ryan Divish of The Seattle Times reports.

St. Louis Cardinals.description: Cardinals president of baseball operations Chaim Bloom said Monday that Fitts (lat) is on track to be ready at the start of spring training but will have his workload monitored, Derrick Goold of the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reports.
Rajcic revealed on his Instagram account Thursday that he recently underwent a right elbow UCL reconstruction.
Dobbins underwent reconstructive surgery on his right elbow Wednesday and is expected to require a 12-month recovery, Derrick Goold of the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reports.

lifecycle.status: Challenger locked; 12/100 new results across 2/8 weeks.

policy.description: After a settled forecast loss, lock a challenger before collecting a new confirmation sample. Promote only for lower log loss, non-worse Brier and accuracy, and a paired weekly bootstrap showing improvement. No changes after a single upset.

outcome_learning.update_policy: Every newly settled decisive result can trigger an eligible adaptive challenger refit. Both wins and losses update causal team/fighter feedback. Larger unexpected outcomes generate larger residuals; live promotion requires independent accuracy, log-loss and Brier checks.

research.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
research.fold_policy: Shared folds start after sufficient training-only history for 80 base and 30 calibration observations with both classes; no validation scores determine dates

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

research.note: Expanding development backtests only. Candidate selection gains are optimistic; no new independent test or production improvement is claimed. Original final-test dates were excluded. Production promotion still requires the separate prospective loss-review gate.

backtest_review.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
backtest_review.fold_policy: Shared folds start after sufficient training-only history for 80 base and 30 calibration observations with both classes; no validation scores determine dates

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

backtest_review.note: Expanding development backtests only. Candidate selection gains are optimistic; no new independent test or production improvement is claimed. Original final-test dates were excluded. Production promotion still requires the separate prospective loss-review gate.

previous_search.note: Same development data and chronological validation games; search-selection optimism remains.

drift.note: Compare the latest 50 saved picks with the preceding 50; this is monitoring, not permission to retune a live model.

actions: Collect more pregame evidence before drawing strong conclusions or promoting a challenger.

calibration.note: Binned reliability and resolution are descriptive. The residual reflects within-bin variation; this is not an exact individual-probability Brier decomposition.

diagnostics.note: Uses only actually saved, settled predictions. Team summaries count a game for both teams and must not be summed as independent games. Drift comparisons are observational; schedule difficulty and small samples can change scores.

feedback_report.note: Original saved pregame forecasts under the current prediction policy. Small samples are noisy; the Wilson accuracy interval is descriptive and assumes independent picks. Wins and losses both inform training; no result rewrites a saved pick.

adaptive_review.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
adaptive_review.fold_policy: Shared folds start after sufficient training-only history for 80 base and 30 calibration observations with both classes; no validation scores determine dates

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

adaptive_review.note: Twenty-one fixed adaptive candidates against the prior development winner, compared on shared expanding pre-final-test dates. Selection is optimistic; only the separate future gate can change production weights.

benchmark.budget: 10 fixed candidates, 3 expanding date-block folds; no random split, no tuning on final 20% of dates; single CPU.

test.interval_note: 200 calendar-week block bootstrap samples of fixed final-test predictions; approximate performance uncertainty, not a game probability interval.

benchmark.outcome_rules: Conditional on a decisive eventual winner, including overtime. Draws and no contests excluded; this is NOT an unconditional win probability or a sportsbook settlement forecast.
benchmark.calibration: No post-hoc calibration; reliability measured on held-out data.
limitations: Result-only baseline; no confirmed injuries, starters, travel, weather or lineups.
Score margin is not possession-adjusted efficiency.
